---
title: "All BANG, little buck"
subtitle: "Basic psychological needs are weakly linked with video gaming behavior"
---

This site hosts the analysis output for the Stage 2 Registered Report.

## Documents

- [**Manuscript**](manuscript.html) --- introduction, methods, confirmatory
  results (Study A), Study B, and discussion
- [**Supplement**](supplement.html) --- design table, full model outputs,
  imputation diagnostics, and the S1--S9 sensitivity analyses

## Pipeline stages

The analysis runs as a [`targets`](https://docs.ropensci.org/targets/)
pipeline. Each stage is a rendered document:

- [Preprocessing](preprocessing.html) --- data loading, telemetry
  aggregation, survey enrichment
- [Multiple imputation](imputation.html) --- MICE and within/between-person
  centering
- [Modelling](modelling.html) --- H1--H3 hypothesis tests and diagnostics
- [Study B](studyb.html) --- PowerWash Simulator session models
